stages.name: Observe
stages.instruction: A ring is pulled by three strings — forces $\vec{F_1}$, $\vec{F_2}$, $\vec{F_3}$. Drag the tip of $\vec{F_3}$ around the ring. On the right, the three forces are drawn head-to-tail (the 'dynamique'). The ring is at equilibrium only when the triangle closes.
stages.concept: For a solid at equilibrium under three coplanar forces: $\vec{F_1} + \vec{F_2} + \vec{F_3} = \vec{0}$. Placed head-to-tail, the three vectors form a closed triangle. Equivalently: $F_{3x} = -(F_{1x} + F_{2x})$ and $F_{3y} = -(F_{1y} + F_{2y})$.

stages.name: Experiment
stages.instruction: Three setups. For each: $\vec{F_1}$ and $\vec{F_2}$ are given (magnitude and angle labeled on the scene). Drag $\vec{F_3}$ until the dynamique closes, then press Confirm (or Space). You have 5 shots for 3 setups.
stages.concept: Aim by closing the triangle visually: the tip of $\vec{F_3}$ must land back on the origin of the dynamique. When it does, $\vec{F_1} + \vec{F_2} + \vec{F_3} = \vec{0}$ holds exactly.

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.instruction: The dynamique panel is hidden. Read $F_1$, $F_2$ and their angles from the ring diagram. Compute $F_{3x} = -(F_{1x} + F_{2x})$ and $F_{3y} = -(F_{1y} + F_{2y})$ on paper, convert to magnitude and angle, drag $\vec{F_3}$ into place, then Confirm. One shot per setup — miss any and the stage restarts.
stages.concept: Project onto axes: $F_{3x} = -(F_1\cos\alpha_1 + F_2\cos\alpha_2)$, $F_{3y} = -(F_1\sin\alpha_1 + F_2\sin\alpha_2)$. Then $F_3 = \sqrt{F_{3x}^2 + F_{3y}^2}$ and $\alpha_3 = \operatorname{atan2}(F_{3y},\, F_{3x})$.

labels.tip1: drag F3 tip — the triangle closes at equilibrium
labels.tip3: sum components, then set F3 and confirm

1.1: Drag the head of the orange F3 arrow (the one from the ring). Watch the right-hand triangle open and close.
1.2: The right panel places F1, F2, F3 head-to-tail. The gap arrow shows how far from equilibrium you are.
1.3: When the triangle closes, F1 + F2 + F3 = 0 — the ring is in equilibrium. The HUD gap goes to 0 N.

2.1: Read F1 and F2 on the ring — magnitude and angle. Drag F3 until the dynamique triangle closes.
2.2: F3 must be exactly the opposite of F1 + F2. Look at where the tip of F2 falls in the dynamique — F3 goes from there back to the origin.
2.3: If you overshoot, the gap arrow points from your F3 tip back to the origin. Nudge F3 in that direction.

3.1: The triangle is hidden. Read F1, F2 and their angles from the labels near the ring.
3.2: Compute F3x = -(F1·cos α1 + F2·cos α2) and F3y = -(F1·sin α1 + F2·sin α2). Then magnitude = √(F3x² + F3y²), angle = atan2(F3y, F3x).
3.3: Peek reveals your current F3 magnitude and angle so you can align them with your paper answer before confirming.
